rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose colloquial choice for being ready or agreeable to do something.

example.english: Are you willing to move to the New Territories for the job?
example.traditional: 你肯為咗份工搬去新界嗎？
example.jyutping: nei5 hang2 wai6 zo2 fan6 gung1 bun1 heoi3 san1 gaai3 maa3

rows.note: Use this when you want to state willingness explicitly or give it a more deliberate tone.

example.english: I am willing to learn how to cook for my family.
example.traditional: 我願意為咗屋企人學識煮飯。
example.jyutping: ngo5 jyun6 ji3 wai6 zo2 uk1 kei2 jan4 hok6 sik1 zyu2 faan6
